name: Goldleaf's Discovery
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council!  Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle.  We know that if anyone can do it, you can.

May fortune go with you, adventurer.  Speak with Aurel when you are ready.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
narrative.offerRewardText: What Huum says is true. I believe I know how to summon a lord of the Abyssal Council! Listen on, and I will explain...

chain.subtitle: 6 quests at level 60, 21,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Goldleaf's Discovery
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Lords of the Council
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Bor Wishes to Speak
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Scepter of the Council
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
